purpose_one_liner: Normalize raw bank transaction descriptions into stable canonical labels and extract City/State into plain text sheet outputs.

trigger_modes.manual: User-triggered run that reads source column C and writes plain text outputs to destination columns C and D.
trigger_modes.scheduled: Not configured in ChatGPT builder; use local cron with dry_run=true until validated.
trigger_modes.preview_vs_live: dry_run=true for preview; dry_run=false with --approved for live writes.

inputs.read_stop_rule: last nonblank row in source column C
